title: Sad Violin
blurb: Maximum pathos, minimum stakes. The melodramatic string melody exists so that something faintly unfortunate can be treated as Shakespearean tragedy — a dropped ice cream, a missed bus, a gamer dying to the least dangerous enemy in the game. That mismatch has anchored ironic editing since the YouTube montage era and shows no sign of exhausting itself. The trick is to play it entirely straight and let the strings handle the sarcasm. It stops being funny the moment the misfortune is genuinely significant, and that line is worth keeping an eye on.
origin: The classic ironic-tragedy backing track from the YouTube montage era.
